image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) adhering to a rocky substrate. The chiton has an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal shell composed of eight overlapping plates embedded in a textured, leathery girdle. The surrounding rock is covered in small barnacles and other marine encrustations. The lighting is natural, highlighting the wet texture of the shell and the roughness of the rock.
